newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W. Europe's IT/telecoms market to grow 7.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: W. Europe's IT/telecoms market to grow 7.1 pct.

text.p: Western Europe's market for information and communications technologies is expected to grow by 7.1 percent in 1997, to 338 billion Ecus ($382 billion), the European Information Technology Observatory (EITO) said on Tuesday.
That follows growth in 1996 of 7.2 percent, faster than the overall economy but lower than the 8.5 percent that EITO forecast last year.
The information technology (IT) market grew 6.5 percent in 1996 and is expected to rise 6.8 percent in 1997, said EITO, an industry-funded research group based in Frankfurt.
The telecommunications market grew 7.9 percent in 1996 and is set to grow 7.3 percent in 1997, it said.
Those figures are down from 1995, when the IT and telecoms market grew 8.1 percent.
